desc: Purchased in 2019 with only 26,000 miles on the clock, I drove this MX-5 Euphonic daily for around a year and a half. Over that time it completed 22k miles and is now sitting at just under 48,000 miles. Despite this, it still presents as one of the lowest mileage examples you'll find. Anytime I wasn't driving it, it lived on my driveway under its cover. During my ownership it's had the below works & modifications: January 2020 Small sub-woofer (Pioneer TS-WX130DA) professionally fitted by Team Impulse between the seats with controller mounted on dash. (I believe the door speakers were already upgraded by the previous owner. The addition of the small sub really makes the sound system complete.) - £400 March 2020 High Performance 8mm Ignition Leads April 2020 HKB Steering Wheel Boss Kit June 2020 BC Racing BR RS Series Coilovers - 15 clicks of damper adjustability - £900 SuperPro Droplinks - £220

Selling my greatly cherished 2002 Mazda MX-5. I have owned this car for the past 4 years as my first car and I have loved every moment in it. It drives fantastically and has had very few mechanical issues during my ownership. It has never failed to put a smile on my face due to the fantastic gearbox feel and sharp handling. It sounds brilliant with an aftermarket exhaust and air intake but not too loud. Seats are remarkably comfortable for a 24 year old sports car! Selling as I wanted something with air-conditioning. Some highlights: -New soft top roof (2025) -4 Michelin all-year tyres -New Front brake pads -MX5 Parts stainless steel backbox (Nice noise, not loud) -Cobalt air intake -Leather handbrake & gait cover -Chrome air vent and gearbox trim -Red/chrome snooker ball gear knob

3 Previous Owners, MOT Until April, Full Service History. Reluctantly selling my much loved Mazda MX-5. In Arctic Trim, this car features both heated seats and air-conditioning, and the more powerful 1.8l Engine. Car has been a joy to drive and well looked after, and has received a new Crank Position, MAF sensor, fuel filter and throttle body in my ownership, alongside other general maintenance. Car is mechanically in great condition, though it does have expected rust in the rear arches seen commonly on these models, and the typical wear and tear scratches expected of a car of this age. Please see the image of the rear boot lock damage from an attempted break in, this does not affect boot operation, and it still locks perfectly fine.

Convertible with hard top as well as soft. Montana spec, and Merlot (red ) colour. General condition good for age. A few scratches and scrapes but no dents, everything works, recently serviced and  MOT'd . Air con needs a re-charge. Was a second car, so low mileage. I have owned it since 2010. Fun car that runs well.

Mazda MX-5 mk1 1994 1.8L White Automatic Features and a few things I fitted to the car since purchasing in 2022: -  BBS cross-spoke alloy wheels - MOMO Indy Heritage Steering Wheel Mahogany Wood 350mm - Wooden Handbrake lever - Set of new tyres (Toyo Proxes CF2 185/60 R14 82H) - Pioneer active subwoofer TS-WX130DA - JVC 6.5 2 way door speakers - Bluetooth stereo unit - Boot / luggage rack - Chrome Windscreen wiper blades

Mazda MX5 NB MK 2.5 euphonic edition - Comes with a factory fitted limited slip differential (LSD). - ULEZ compliant which is rare for these modern classics - 5 speed manual transmission - Fresh MOT until Sep 2027 with only 1 advisory - Heated leather seats - Alpine CD + Bluetooth receiver with 6 disc CD changer in boot Rear sills were welded last year so they have plenty of life left on them. Low mileage for its age, fully functional soft top, everything is in working order. The car has been very well looked after, including indoor parking in the winter for rust protection. The oil was changed 2000 miles ago.

For sale is my Chilli Orange 2005 Mazda MX5 Icon Edition. 58484 miles. The car is in excellent running condition and has a full comprehensive service history, including original dealer documentation. Over the years I have owned this car, It has had numerous modifications including: K&N Cold air intake Mx5parts Stainless Steel exhaust 4x MeisterR Coilovers Cobra rear strut brace 4x New Rota Alloys. 2 New front brake disks and new offside front caliper, this rectified the common issue of the front brakes on these cars seizing. The car is also being sold with the "Brilliant Black" Hard top pictured in the photos, underneath this the soft top is in excellent condition and was freshly treated and dried before being folded away. I have retained the original parts for everything I have modified, and can include these in the purchase if you so wish - this will allow you to return the car to stock if you prefer this.

This is my Grace Green Mazda Mx-5  1.8L VVT. It has done just under 26400 genuine miles and it's in outstanding condition for the year. It is completely stock which is very rare for an NB Mx-5. It has a full service history mostly with Mazda and the rest independent specialists. It is MOT'd until October 2026, comes with two keys, a tonneau cover and luggage rack. 4950 or best offer

I've owned this MX5 for 20 years and it's been serviced regularly and looked after. LONG MOT UNTIL SEPTEMBER 2027. Tyres in excellent condition, alloys in  good condition. Heated leather seats and interior all clean and in good condition. 6 CD player. CDs stored in the player itself. Wood effect trim with Nardi Torino gear knob and steering wheel. The exterior is in generally good condition, but has the usual rust for an MX5 of this age occurring on the rear wheel arches. The driver' Chrome effect wing mirrors, petrol cap, windscreen wash squirters and mesh type grill on front. The hood is in very good condition due to having a hardtop being used during the winter months. The driver's side rear wheel arches has sun fading on the red paintwork. New battery fitted September 2026.

Very original Limited Edition California in exceptional condition. Always garaged and almost excusively used to attend MX5 Owners Club events. Small rust spot on rear wheel arch and sill repaired last week with a professional polish at a cost of 700 Pounds.

Purchased new in Feb 2002 so only one owner from new and has only done 65200 miles since. Full-service history. Always garaged and very rarely used in poor weather. Sadly, due to health have had to give up driving so car needs another loving caring home. As a model from 2002, this vehicle represents a classic era of the MX-5, known for its straightforward engineering and driver-focused design.

Reluctantly selling  my cherished MX-5 (with two young kids now in tow she is just not being driven as much as she should be). A joy to drive. Exceptionally well looked after by me for almost a decade - regular servicing, brakes overhauled about a year ago, re-sprays etc. Receipts available and happy to talk you through the work done. Sills professionally re-welded a couple of years ago to address the usual MX-5 rust issue. Receipt available, and garage happy to talk to any buyer directly. Original alloys have some age-related corrosion, visible in photos. Open to offers.

Selling my Mazda mx5 icon. - Low mileage at 47000 - Kept in garage for the past year - Underside has no rust and is sealed - 1.8 vvt engine producing 146bhp - Two new front tyres - Icon trim including heated seats, heated back window and black micra paint. - MOT until 26 march 2027 Any questions contact me and I can help you out.

As a well-established model, it combines reliable engineering with the engaging handling characteristics that the Mazda MX-5 is known for and is in stunning Tornado Red
